default_platform_fee_percent.label: Default Wholesale Platform Fee (%)
default_platform_fee_percent.description: Fallback platform commission fee applied when category-specific fee is not defined

category_platform_fees.label: Category-Wise Platform Fees (%)
category_platform_fees.description: Individual platform fee percentages for all 38 industry sectors applied across RFQs, product additions, and checkout

high_value_threshold.label: High-Value Deal Threshold (₹)
high_value_threshold.description: Contract value threshold (₹10,00,000) at or above which flat advance rules apply

high_value_advance_base.label: High-Value Base Advance (₹)
high_value_advance_base.description: Base advance locked for wholesale deals >= ₹10,00,000

high_value_upi_fee.label: High-Value UPI Platform Fee (₹)
high_value_upi_fee.description: Flat UPI platform surcharge (making total ₹1,00,000 for UPI checkout)

cards_surcharge_rate_percent.label: Cards & NetBanking Surcharge (%)
cards_surcharge_rate_percent.description: Razorpay processing fee for Credit/Debit Cards and NetBanking

standard_advance_percent.label: Standard Deal Advance Rate (%)
standard_advance_percent.description: Advance percentage required for orders below ₹10,00,000

default_gst_percent.label: Default GST Rate (%)
default_gst_percent.description: Standard Goods & Services Tax rate applicable across general commodities

default_min_order_qty.label: Default Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)
default_min_order_qty.description: Standard fallback minimum wholesale quantity for new product listings

escrow_hold_hours.label: Escrow Price Lock Window (Hours)
escrow_hold_hours.description: Duration for which supplier price and allocation is guaranteed after advance booking

platform_maintenance_mode.label: Platform Maintenance Mode
platform_maintenance_mode.description: When enabled, displays maintenance banner to non-admin visitors

supported_currency.label: Base Platform Currency
supported_currency.description: Primary trading currency for settlement ledgers and Razorpay gateway

annual_plan_original_price.label: Annual Plan Original / Strikethrough Price (₹)
annual_plan_original_price.description: Original list price shown with strikethrough (e.g. ₹20,000) on annual membership cards

annual_plan_base_price.label: Annual Plan Selling Base Price (₹)
annual_plan_base_price.description: Net selling base price for 12 months supplier membership before GST and gateway charges

annual_plan_gst_percent.label: Annual Plan GST Rate (%)
annual_plan_gst_percent.description: Goods & Services Tax rate applied to annual membership base price (default 18%)

annual_plan_gateway_fee_percent.label: Annual Plan Razorpay Gateway Fee (%)
annual_plan_gateway_fee_percent.description: Payment gateway surcharge percentage applied on subtotal with GST (default 2.5%)
